name: tracebrain
description: Your second brain, built from your own conversations: the people you talk to, what was decided, and what you owe - readable and writable by your assistant.

remember_sessions.title: Offer to remember what a session settled
remember_sessions.description: At the end of a session, ask whether anything durable about you or your work belongs on your own page. Off by default: it costs one model turn per session, and most sessions settle nothing worth keeping.
